snippet.title: Grandia HD Collection - Launch Trailer | PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008436/

The GRANDIA HD Collection launches on PlayStation 4 today! Experience two games that forever changed the RPG landscape, now available in stunning HD.

GRANDIA: Dive into the captivating journey of Justin and his allies as they race against the sinister Garlyle Forces. Unravel the mysteries of a forgotten civilization and immerse yourself in an RPG hailed as a timeless classic, inspiring generations of games to come.

GRANDIA II: Step into the shoes of Ryudo, a jaded Geohound with a noble heart, as he embarks on a magical quest alongside a group of unlikely allies. Their journey is riddled with twists and turns as they seek a divine weapon to save the world. 

#ps4 #ps4games #grandiahdremaster
